name: Mail (Mail.app)
description: Read and organize the real Mail.app mailbox on this Mac through the bundled mail-app-cli: accounts, mailboxes, messages, bodies, attachments and drafts. It cannot send mail and it cannot delete mail.
whenToUse: Use when the user asks about their own email: unread mail, a mailbox, a specific message or attachment, searching mail, marking/archiving/quarantining messages, reading a message body, or drafting a reply for review in Mail.app.
author: spoon

items.name: operations
items.description: mail-app-cli 的读写工作流、参数约定、性能代价与踩坑表 (workflows, conventions, pitfalls)

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List the operations this plugin can run. Call with no category for an overview (category name + operation count); call with a category to get every operation in it with its parameters and that category's RULES. Read the RULES before calling call_tool.

category.title: Category
category.description: Category name from the overview: read | write | attachment | system

tools.name: call_tool
tools.description: Run one operation against the real Mail.app on this Mac. name comes from list_tools; args is that operation's own parameter object, passed through to the bundled mail-app-cli (for example {"action":"messages.unified","params":{"box":"unread"}} is args {"box":"unread"} for name "messages.unified"). Returns the raw result envelope { ok, okCount, failed, results[] } where each result has ok, dryRun, data and error{code,hint}: branch on error.code, never on the prose. This plugin cannot send mail and cannot delete mail. Dry-run (dryRun:true) anything that touches more than one message before applying it.

name.title: Operation
name.description: Operation name from list_tools, e.g. messages.unified

args.title: Arguments
args.description: The operation's parameter object, e.g. {"box":"unread","limit":10,"format":"compact"}. Unknown or misspelled fields are rejected, never ignored. Pass {} to get a parameter error that names the problem.
